{
  "decision": "uncertain",
  "confidence": "medium",
  "summary": "A provenance warning for large rotation frames raises motion concern, but primary IQMs show a mixed pattern: fwhm_avg is elevated (95th percentile) consistent with blurring, yet SNR metrics are mid-range and CNR is unremarkable, preventing a clear pass or fail.",
  "flagged_metrics": [
    "fwhm_avg",
    "large_rot_frame",
    "snr_gm",
    "snr_wm",
    "cjv",
    "tpm_overlap_csf",
    "tpm_overlap_gm",
    "tpm_overlap_wm"
  ],
  "reasons": [
    "large_rot_frame=true (provenance warning) — at least one frame with large rotation detected, raising concern for motion artifact during acquisition.",
    "fwhm_avg=4.638, percentile=95.8 — image spatial sharpness is at the high end of the distribution, consistent with motion-induced blurring or smoothing artifact.",
    "cjv=0.308, percentile=6.4 — unexpectedly low CJV is atypical; while lower CJV is nominally favorable, an extreme low value in the context of motion and blurring may reflect segmentation or intensity distribution distortion rather than genuine tissue separability.",
    "snr_gm=14.23, percentile=34.9 and snr_wm=23.03, percentile=31.7 — both tissue-specific SNR metrics are in the lower-mid range, providing no strong reassurance of image quality but not reaching failure thresholds.",
    "tpm_overlap across all three tissue classes (CSF=0.170 at 1.6th percentile, GM=0.459 at 3.3rd percentile, WM=0.512 at 4.7th percentile) — consistently low overlap with tissue probability maps across all compartments may reflect registration failure, segmentation distortion, or image quality degradation.",
    "fber=22400, percentile=98.6 — very high foreground-to-background energy ratio is a favorable signal, suggesting clean background; this conflicts with the motion/blurring indicators and prevents a straightforward fail decision."
  ],
  "recommended_followup": [
    "Visually inspect axial, coronal, and sagittal slices for ringing, ghosting, or blurring artifacts consistent with the flagged large rotation frame.",
    "Review the motion parameter time series from the scanner or reconstruction log to characterize the magnitude and timing of the large rotation event.",
    "Assess whether the low TPM overlap values reflect a registration/segmentation failure secondary to image quality degradation or an anatomical outlier.",
    "Check snrd_gm (137.3, 99.7th percentile) and snrd_wm (192.2, 99.7th percentile) — extremely high background-relative SNR may indicate an unusually suppressed background mask; verify air mask validity given summary_bg_stdv at 0.2nd percentile.",
    "If visual inspection confirms motion blurring or ringing, reclassify as fail; if the image appears structurally intact, reclassify as pass."
  ]
}
```
